summary: Implemented grid-sampled patch iteration: PatchIter (new, exported from monai.data), reworked GridPatchDataset (injected patch_iter, per-patch transform, with_coordinates default true), iter_patch now yields (patch, coordinates) pairs, set_rnd skips dunder attributes, PatchDataset docstring float fix, docs/source/data.rst PatchIter entry, and new tests/test_grid_dataset.py (test_shape, test_loading_array, test_missing_length). Nothing was run and nothing committed. Known gaps: test_loading_array has no literal patch-value constants (checks constant per-patch shift in [-1,1] instead), and the multi-worker check compares coordinate sets rather than values. Docstring example outputs were derived by hand.
